dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual symmetrical narrowing of the visible lateral width from the mid-section toward the posterior peduncle region.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light grey to pale-white median pixel intensity across the dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Diffuse, low-frequency darker grey shading concentrated on the anterior dorsal surface and along the midline.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse, low-gradient transitions between the primary light-grey base and the slightly darker mottled areas.
